slice: M3 Slice F + audit follow-on + Slice G + Slice E1 + Slice H
scope: canonical-spec correctness pass + per-wave equals coalescing + replay buffer + typed-error promotion
premise: Slice E rework had unblocked higher-order ops, but a systematic walk through the canonical spec surfaced 10+ documented divergences accumulated through M1–M3 Slice E. Slice F is the comprehensive correctness pass — fixing them in-slice rather than deferring to a 'v1 limitations' pile. Slice G fixes the bug Slice F's audit debug_assert exposed. Slice E1 lands the replay buffer (R2.6.5/Lock 6.G). Slice H promotes ~150 register*/set_pausable_mode call sites from assert! panics to typed Result.

traces.title: Pause-overflow ERROR synthesis

steps.internal: binding allocates Box<PauseOverflowDiagnostic{...}> → error_handle; Core::error(node, error_handle)

traces.commentary: Pre-Slice-F this was a silent drop. Now structured ERROR with {nodeId, droppedCount, configuredMax, lockHeldDurationMs}.

traces.title: PausableMode { Default, ResumeAll, Off } consolidation

steps.event: set_pausable_mode(d, Default) (where d derived on s)

steps.internal: s wave fires; d would normally fire, but PAUSED Default → buffer dep delivery only (one slot per dep)

traces.commentary: ResumeAll (pre-Slice-F default) replays each delivery. Off is a pause no-op.

traces.title: R1.3.2.d per-wave equals coalescing

steps.internal: first emit — tier3_emitted_this_wave.insert(s); equals → Resolved (Identity); pending_notify[s] = Resolved
already in tier3_emitted_this_wave → skip equals, queue Data verbatim. Retroactive rewrite: any prior Resolved for s in pending_notify is rewritten to Data(snapshot) using wave-start cache.

traces.commentary: Pre-fix [Resolved, Data(h2)] violated R1.3.3.a (Resolved must discharge once per wave). Slice F audit added the dev-mode debug_assert; Slice G fixed and re-enabled it.

traces.title: Replay buffer subscribe handshake

steps.internal: buffer.len > cap → evict h1 (deferred_handle_releases.push(h1)); buffer=[h2, h3]

traces.commentary: Slice F /qa A1 dedupe: if last replay entry equals cache slice (Identity), skip the duplicate.

traces.title: Core::up + UpError tier-based dispatch

steps.internal: UnknownNode check first (A10) → 999 not registered → Err(UpError::UnknownNode)
tier check after node check → Err(UpError::UnsupportedTier) (use Core::emit)
Core::invalidate(node) (R1.4.2: cascades via dep-walk in Core::invalidate; documented divergence vs plain-forward)

traces.commentary: Higher-order outer sinks + producer sinks (~26 sites) refactored from match m { Data | Complete | Error } → match m.tier() + payload_handle().

assessment.summary: The Slice F audit pass closed >10 documented divergences in a single slice; Slice G closed the bug it surfaced; Slice E1 added missing R2.6.5 substrate; Slice H promoted ~150 sites from panic to typed Result without breaking any existing test. 17 distinct concerns in Slice H /qa; 13 closed in /qa, 3 deferred with explicit reason, 1 (F2) was the headline correctness win (TOCTOU).
